core_claim: Across 15 seasons in Europe's top leagues, almost every football manager performs within a hair's breadth of what their squad's quality already predicts — and the few who genuinely lift their teams are rare exceptions, not the rule fans imagine.

edt_01.label: Hook — The miracle that wasn't a miracle
edt_01.title: The miracle that wasn't a miracle
edt_01.editorial_notes: Lead with Leicester (1.07 ppg above expectation), then immediately undercut with the distribution. Do not reorder.

edt_02.label: Methodology — A model the betting markets respect
edt_02.title: A model the betting markets respect
edt_02.editorial_notes: Mention 27,390 fixtures, MAE 7.27 across 1,470 team-seasons, correlation 0.80. Do not skip the betting-market benchmark — it is what licenses the rest of the analysis.

edt_03.label: The leaderboard — short, brilliant, unfamiliar
edt_03.title: The leaderboard nobody expects
edt_03.editorial_notes: Top of the chart should highlight Abelardo (#1), Ranieri's Leicester (mid-pack).

edt_04.label: Tenure-1 vs tenure-2 — the killer test
edt_04.title: The killer test
edt_04.editorial_notes: r = 0.04 is the killer number; 45% vs 37% conditional probabilities back it up. The interactive should let readers select a manager and see their two tenures.

edt_05.label: Why a single season tells you almost nothing
edt_05.title: Why a single season tells you almost nothing
edt_05.editorial_notes: 461 games of zero must be added. 7.6% retention for a single season. Ferguson at 43% retention. Image should be Ferguson-era atmosphere — touchline, weather, time-passing.

edt_06.label: Klopp, the textbook
edt_06.title: Klopp, the textbook
edt_06.editorial_notes: Stair-step trajectory across Mainz → Dortmund → Liverpool: +0.05, +0.18, +0.31 must read in order.

edt_07.label: Famous names, slimmer margins
edt_07.title: The famous-name table is not what you think
edt_07.editorial_notes: Ancelotti's negative-to-zero margins are the surprise. Visual should let readers browse manager-by-manager.

edt_08.label: The active board, projected
edt_08.title: The active board, projected
edt_08.editorial_notes: Dual story: top-10 leaderboard, then the long left tail of 432 sub-average projections. Interactive lets reader pick a band and see how many managers fall in it.

edt_09.label: Close — what this does and does not say
edt_09.title: What this data does, and does not, say
edt_09.editorial_notes: Pure editorial close. Manager-severance figure (£90m, 2018-19) and 'post-sacking bounce as regression to the mean' are the two anchors. Do not introduce new statistics.
